column2: Late-night talk-show lounge: deep midnight-navy stage, glowing neon-tube lettering in hot magenta and electric cyan, polished chrome trim, soft haze and spotlight cones, warm amber bulbs, a sly grown-up cocktail-hour mood.

Swiss International Typographic Style / Bauhaus game board: strict modular grid, flat solid blocks of signal red, cobalt blue, sun yellow and black on off-white, enormous grotesque numerals, thick rules, circles and squares, zero ornament, crisp and confident.

Art Deco casino night: black lacquer and champagne gold, geometric sunburst fans, stepped borders, a roulette-wheel-inspired number line, elegant high-contrast Deco display numerals, emerald felt accents, glamorous 1920s high-roller mood.

1970s TV game show set: chunky rounded bubbly display type, burnt orange, harvest gold, chocolate brown and avocado, marquee light bulbs around big flip-number boards, wood panelling, warm cheesy broadcast glow.

Retro computer terminal quiz: dark CRT glass, glowing amber phosphor monospace type and pixel-block graphics, subtle scanlines and bloom, ASCII box-drawing borders, a number line drawn in characters, 1980s mainframe mood.

Cosy pub-quiz night: dark slate chalkboard in a warm wooden frame, hand-lettered chalk typography in white with a few colored chalks, brass details, Edison bulbs, pint-glass amber glow, friendly and handmade.

Y2K chrome and holographic: liquid-metal chrome 3D numerals, iridescent pastel holographic gradients, a glossy grid floor receding to the horizon, star sparkles, bubbly translucent panels, late-90s music-video energy.

Broadsheet newspaper editorial: black ink on warm newsprint, bold condensed serif headlines, tabular figures like a stock-market table, hairline column rules, one spot red accent, halftone photo-style texture, sharp and witty like a crossword page.
